question: What merit results from offering to the deity in summer?
premises: An offering is made to the deity in summer.
Such an offering yields the fruit of the agniṣṭoma sacrifice.
inference: Therefore, summer offerings to the deity confer the merit of an agniṣṭoma.
plain_english: O fair-complexioned one, offerings made in summer would yield the fruit of the agniṣṭoma sacrifice.
